enemy.name: The Wall
enemy.blurb: One huge body, nothing else. Can you kill it before the fight grinds you down?

lines: Bracer holds the line for about 32s.
Bracer + Vex drop the Wall around 25s.
projection.verdict: Comfortable floor. Should hold up — a slam is the wildcard.
projection.chainLine: Chain: expect ~3 this fight. Bracer's chain takes the next slam for the squad.

enemy.name: Pack
enemy.blurb: Five bodies, no line to break. Can you outlast the weight of numbers?

lines: Hollow holds the line for about 11s.
Hollow + Vex should win this in about 19s.
projection.verdict: Rough floor. You'll need a break — or a fast chain — to pull this out.
projection.chainLine: Chain: expect ~5 this fight. Vex's chain hits every enemy at once.

enemy.name: Warden
enemy.blurb: It heals as fast as you can hurt it. Can you burst through faster than it mends?

lines: Bracer holds the line for about 11s.
Bracer + Rook + Vex drop the Warden around 12s.
projection.verdict: Rough floor. You'll need a break — or a fast chain — to pull this out.
projection.chainLine: Chain: expect ~3 this fight. Vex's chain hits every enemy at once.

enemy.name: Executioner
enemy.blurb: Its slam goes straight for your weakest hero, tank or no tank. Can they survive?

lines: Bracer holds the line for about 13s.
Bracer + Rook drop the Executioner around 18s.
projection.verdict: Rough floor. You'll need a break — or a fast chain — to pull this out.
projection.chainLine: Chain: expect ~6 this fight. Bracer's chain takes the next slam for the squad.

enemy.name: Vanguard
enemy.blurb: Its slam goes for your weakest hero — and small hits keep changing who that is. Can they survive?

lines: Hollow holds the line for about 20s.
Hollow + Rook drop the Vanguard around 22s.
projection.verdict: Rough floor. You'll need a break — or a fast chain — to pull this out.
projection.chainLine: Chain: expect ~6 this fight. Rook's chain hits the biggest enemy, over and over.
